parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of non-ASCII domain names in email headers by converting them to Punycode. The change is minimal and focused, with a new test file to reproduce the issue.

issues.description: The new test file `reproduce.py` is not part of the standard test suite and should be integrated into the existing tests for better maintainability.
